message.dead_air.hunt.vo.convoy: Refugee stop on the trail. We're holding position — need an escort.

message.dead_air.survivor.lost_downed: %s went down alone — dragged back to base. Revive them there before they bleed out.
message.dead_air.survivor.reunion.1: %s: Glad you're alive. Thought I lost you out there.
message.dead_air.survivor.reunion.2: %s: Made it back. Don't leave me hanging next time.
message.dead_air.survivor.reunion.3: %s: Radio's quiet without you. Ready when you are.

title.dead_air.listener.final_sub: Silence it with the Signal Breaker
hud.dead_air.listener.listening_hint: Crouch and stay quiet — don't sprint.
hud.dead_air.listener.listening_quiet: Quiet… it's struggling to find you.
survivor.dead_air.line.stranded.scavenge: You heard the call? I've been picking through this place for days. Get me out of here and I'll share what I find.
survivor.dead_air.line.stranded.medic: Thank god. I've got bandages and not much else. Take me somewhere safe and I'll patch you up.
survivor.dead_air.line.stranded.radio_op: That was my signal. I kept it going as long as the battery lasted. I can keep a radio alive, if you keep me alive.
survivor.dead_air.line.stranded.pilot: Bird's down. I'm not. Get me somewhere with a clear LZ and I can fly whatever you've got left.
survivor.dead_air.line.stranded.military: Unit's gone. Rules of engagement still apply. Point me at a problem and I'll handle it.
survivor.dead_air.line.stranded.civilian: I wasn't cut out for this. Just… don't leave me alone out here.
survivor.dead_air.line.missing: I got separated… hurt my leg. Lead me home and I'll follow.
survivor.dead_air.line.settled: Quiet here. I like it. Come back in a couple of days.
survivor.dead_air.line.supplies_ready: I put something aside for you.
survivor.dead_air.hope.find_family: I still hope they're out there somewhere.
survivor.dead_air.hope.safe_home: I just want four walls that stay quiet at night.
survivor.dead_air.hope.fix_the_signal: If we can keep the towers up, people can find each other.
survivor.dead_air.hope.see_the_ocean: I used to dream about the coast. Still do.
survivor.dead_air.hope.stock_a_cache: Every spare scrap goes in the cache. One day it'll matter.
survivor.dead_air.hope.quiet_days: No broadcasts. No screaming. Just quiet days.
survivor.dead_air.who.scavenger: I'm %s — a %s. Combat: %s. If it isn't nailed down, I'll find a use for it.
survivor.dead_air.who.medic: I'm %s — a %s. Style: %s. Keep them breathing; I'll handle the rest.
survivor.dead_air.who.radio_operator: Name's %s. %s. Combat: %s. Someone has to keep the signal honest.
survivor.dead_air.who.pilot: %s. %s. Orientation: %s. Point me at a clear LZ and I'll get you out.
survivor.dead_air.who.military: %s. %s. I fight %s. Give me a target and a lane.
survivor.dead_air.who.civilian: I'm %s — a %s. Style: %s. Train me at base if you need more than that.
survivor.dead_air.idle.scavenger.0: %s rattles a pouch. 'Found three bolts and a prayer. Progress.'
survivor.dead_air.idle.scavenger.1: 'Leave the shiny bits. I'll sweep the ground behind you.'
survivor.dead_air.idle.scavenger.2: 'Every corpse is a kit if you're not squeamish.'
survivor.dead_air.idle.scavenger.3: 'Don't step on the good scrap. That's dinner.'
survivor.dead_air.idle.medic.0: %s checks a bandage roll. 'Pulse first. Heroics second.'
survivor.dead_air.idle.medic.1: 'If someone drops, call me — don't drag them.'
survivor.dead_air.idle.medic.2: 'I can patch holes. I can't invent blood.'
survivor.dead_air.idle.medic.3: 'Stay close when things get loud. Easier to sew.'
survivor.dead_air.idle.radio_operator.0: %s taps an earpiece. 'Static's clean tonight. Relatively.'
survivor.dead_air.idle.radio_operator.1: 'Keep the music on — I sync better when the tower sings.'
survivor.dead_air.idle.radio_operator.2: 'Frequency drift means someone's listening. Or something.'
survivor.dead_air.idle.radio_operator.3: 'I'll watch the dials. You watch the treeline.'
survivor.dead_air.idle.pilot.0: %s glances at the sky. 'Need a bird and a pad. Until then, I sit the base.'
survivor.dead_air.idle.pilot.1: 'Wind's wrong for a lift. Doesn't mean I stop checking.'
survivor.dead_air.idle.pilot.2: 'When you've got a Chinook, I'm already strapped in.'
survivor.dead_air.idle.pilot.3: 'Ground pounders walk. I wait for rotors.'
survivor.dead_air.idle.military.0: %s checks a strap. 'Formation tight. Eyes out.'
survivor.dead_air.idle.military.2: 'I've cleared worse blocks than this. Still don't get cocky.'
survivor.dead_air.idle.military.3: 'On me if it breaks. Off me if it doesn't.'
survivor.dead_air.idle.civilian.0: %s shrugs. 'I can hold a flashlight. Training would help.'
survivor.dead_air.idle.civilian.1: 'I'm not useless — I'm unfinished. Base can fix that.'
survivor.dead_air.idle.civilian.2: 'Tell me where to stand. I'll stand there.'
survivor.dead_air.idle.civilian.3: 'One day I'll have a real job. Until then… coffee?'
